task.title: Unfold a category from the collapsed rail
task.description:
With sidebar categories (feat/sidebar-categories, 2026-10-08) the collapsed rail shows a category as a thin divider labeled with its initials and hides its projects when the category is folded. There is no control in the rail to unfold it, so a folded category's projects cannot be reached with the pointer without expanding the sidebar first (Cmd+N and Cmd+B still reach them). Make the rail divider clickable to toggle the fold, and consider a glyph that reads less like a project key tile (a single-letter divider such as P sits beside tiles like P1).

Also: a stale comment in desktop/src/renderer/styles.css (around the project-key rail tile styles) still says "a 76px tile"; the rail is 88px since PR #165 (RAIL_WIDTH is derived in layout.js). Fix the wording while touching the rail.
